current_path: GLFW dispatches named then typed WindowResized on the default EventSystem; payload has framebuffer size only.
consumers: Existing resize listeners; platform rendering services
recommendation: Preserve compatibility; use a separate authoritative view source for simulation consumers.
publication_and_delivery: Platform producer; delivery adapter required for simulation callbacks.
contract_notes: Borrowed Window pointer; nested named listeners can invert typed observations; named exception can prevent typed dispatch.

occurrence: Runtime view committed: logical and framebuffer sizes
current_path: Runtime samples both dimensions; TickContext exposes them; neither UI Session subscribes to view changes.
consumers: TGUI; RmlUi; cameras; layout and render policy services
recommendation: Expose a runtime/context view snapshot and change subscription; bind context-created sessions automatically.
publication_and_delivery: Capture on platform owner; commit and notify on simulation owner before the matching update.
contract_notes: Copied sizes plus scoped identity and revision; initial state, coalescing, shutdown and tick coherence required.

current_path: Logical callback updates its cache without dispatch; framebuffer channel need not fire.
consumers: UI logical layout; pointer coordinate conversion
recommendation: Cover either changed dimension in W02; no separate resize API is necessary.
publication_and_delivery: Same committed view publication as W02.
contract_notes: This is one case of W02, not an additional independent implementation project.

occurrence: Native window focus gained or lost
current_path: Input update detects changed GLFW_FOCUSED and logs it; no public focus record.
consumers: Pause/mute policy; UI blur; gameplay capture policy
recommendation: Publish observed native focus with an initial snapshot; keep it separate from keyboard routing focus.
publication_and_delivery: Platform observation; simulation delivery at an input/update boundary.
contract_notes: Polling observes final focus state; it cannot promise every transient native transition. Do not relabel previously captured input.

current_path: Framebuffer zero extents can be sampled; no native iconify state callback or public lifecycle payload.
consumers: Suspend rendering; background policy; accessibility services
recommendation: Decide whether explicit native visibility state is needed beyond zero framebuffer size.
publication_and_delivery: Add platform observation first; deliver copied state on selected owner.
contract_notes: Do not equate zero extent, iconification, occlusion and focus.

current_path: set_mode changes native state, updates sizes and logs; caller has direct control.
consumers: Settings UI; embedded tools; renderer policy
recommendation: Optional applied-mode notification after a successful commit for independent observers.
publication_and_delivery: Platform owner publishes after mode and size caches are updated.
contract_notes: Request acceptance is not a native transition; include window identity and actual mode; reuse W02 for resulting extents.

current_path: Runtime polls should_close and requests/stages shutdown through its existing control flow.
consumers: Save prompt; diagnostics; application lifetime coordinator
recommendation: Consider an observational close-request signal; a veto protocol would be a separate API decision.
publication_and_delivery: Observe on platform before the stop decision; define useful delivery before simulation closure.
contract_notes: An asynchronous notification alone cannot implement cancel/confirm semantics.

current_path: Monitor inventory is captured at construction; no hotplug callback or refresh contract.
consumers: Display settings; fullscreen rebinding; monitor-aware services
recommendation: Retain deferred monitor-service work; settle stable identities and invalidated native handles first.
publication_and_delivery: Platform display owner; deliver copied inventory revisions.
contract_notes: Already deferred in long-term planning; not a currently implemented channel that forgot to dispatch.

current_path: Monitor content scale can be queried; no per-window content-scale callback or payload.
recommendation: Decide explicit scale semantics separately from W02's framebuffer/logical ratio.
publication_and_delivery: Platform observation; simulation-owned policy updates.
contract_notes: Monitor scale and pixel ratio are distinct values; coordinate with W08.

occurrence: Window position or maximized state changed
current_path: No corresponding native callback registration or public state-change payload.
recommendation: Add only with a consumer and supported state query/payload.
publication_and_delivery: Platform owner; coalesce placement samples if only final state matters.
contract_notes: Define restored versus maximized placement; avoid introducing unsupported native assumptions.

occurrence: Pointer entered or left a window
current_path: Cursor movement is captured; no cursor-enter callback is installed.
recommendation: Add to the ordered input path if UI interaction needs the transition.
publication_and_delivery: Platform input collection; preserve sequence relative to pointer records.
contract_notes: A generic bus must not reorder this relative to captured input.

current_path: No native drop callback or owned drop payload.
recommendation: Optional platform capability with copied paths and documented acceptance policy.
publication_and_delivery: Copy callback paths before return; deliver on the consumer owner.
contract_notes: Native callback storage must never escape by reference.

current_path: Ordered owned records with sequence, time, target, focus epoch and gameplay gating are transferred in poll snapshots.
consumers: UI sessions; gameplay controllers; action mapping
recommendation: Retain the input stream instead of duplicating each record on EventBus.
publication_and_delivery: Platform capture; runtime transfers whole polls to the simulation tick.
contract_notes: Tick views are borrowed for the call; preserve whole-poll ordering and old epoch handling.

current_path: Bindings commit immutable action snapshots consumed by tick input.
recommendation: Retain snapshot and edge semantics; application may publish domain actions after consumption.
publication_and_delivery: Bindings/poll owner then simulation tick.
contract_notes: Do not replay edges across recovery updates.

current_path: Availability transition is detected and logged; backend-specific device snapshot is queryable; controls are reconciled.
consumers: Reconnect UI; controller assignment; pause policy
recommendation: Expose a copied availability transition through the generic input service.
publication_and_delivery: Publish with the completed poll; deliver before related simulation input use.
contract_notes: Keep synthetic releases/neutral axes; include device identity and generation if identities may be reused.

current_path: Explicit initialize/deinitialize calls, callback installation/removal and logs.
recommendation: Keep ordered lifecycle calls; add observational fanout only for independent tools.
publication_and_delivery: Platform lifecycle owner; detach notification must precede destination closure.
contract_notes: Late simulation messages after teardown are not a delivery contract.

current_path: Focus leases, epochs, current focus queries and owns_focus checks exist.
recommendation: Retain lease ownership; optional requested-focus telemetry must say requested.
publication_and_delivery: Requests can cross threads; effective routing is latched by the poll owner.
contract_notes: Requested current focus can differ from the focus that labeled an already completed poll.

occurrence: Routing focus applied or session preempted
current_path: Effective routing is latched privately; sessions notice preemption while draining records; PollSnapshot lacks effective focus.
consumers: Shared UI coordinator; input diagnostics; focus policy
recommendation: Consider an applied-routing snapshot/notification tied to poll identity.
publication_and_delivery: Publish at the input latch/commit; process old captured records before session blur.
contract_notes: Do not substitute runtime's post-poll requested-focus diagnostic for effective focus.

current_path: Capture leases and counts are latched at the poll boundary.
recommendation: Keep lease behavior; add applied-capture telemetry only if a consumer needs acknowledgement.
publication_and_delivery: Input poll owner; copy effective flags and poll revision.
contract_notes: Accepted lease and applied capture are different observations.

occurrence: Action context installed/removed at a poll boundary
current_path: Attach returns a lease; pending installs/removals are applied by bindings; snapshots expose results.
recommendation: Optional applied-context acknowledgement for independent observers.
publication_and_delivery: Bindings owner at begin_poll; notification after state commit.
contract_notes: Do not announce installation merely because a request/lease was created.

current_path: Generic service offers convenience keyboard/mouse/gamepad IDs; backend manages one convenience pad.
consumers: Local multiplayer; remapping screens; device picker
recommendation: Design an inventory with stable identity and supported device capabilities before broad hotplug events.
publication_and_delivery: Platform device owner; publish owned inventory revisions.
contract_notes: I03 can be implemented independently; it does not imply a full multi-device service.

current_path: Game init/quiesce/deinit hooks, run result/exception and lifecycle logs already govern ordering.
recommendation: Optional observational lifecycle events for independent services; retain mandatory direct hooks.
publication_and_delivery: Runtime owner; specify last deliverable simulation phase.
contract_notes: Simulation dispatcher closes before quiesce; failure events must preserve first-failure behavior.

current_path: Shared stop_source/stop_token and request_stop are exposed.
recommendation: Retain stop_token for cancellation; add a reason model only if required.
publication_and_delivery: Existing stop semantics; observer callbacks require an explicit owner adapter.
contract_notes: Stop requested, quiesced and stopped are separate states.

occurrence: Lag recovery or dropped simulation time
current_path: Tick carries update_kind and dropped_seconds; runtime records counters/logs.
consumers: Game time policy; HUD diagnostics; telemetry
recommendation: Use tick data for update decisions; optional coalesced telemetry for other observers.
publication_and_delivery: Simulation update owner.
contract_notes: Avoid a second high-frequency stream that disagrees with the tick.

occurrence: Input backlog or scheduler pressure crossed a threshold
current_path: Backlog/lag pressure is counted/logged; live RuntimeStats querying is rejected during run.
consumers: Adaptive policies; runtime monitors; embedded tooling
recommendation: If live observation is needed, publish owner snapshots or threshold transitions.
publication_and_delivery: Runtime samples owner state and emits outside scheduler locks.
contract_notes: Define sampling/coalescing; aggregate counters are not a lossless incident history.

current_path: Runtime scheduling, retained frames and diagnostic counters encode outcomes.
recommendation: Prefer sampled tracing/counters; add scoped observation only for a measured consumer.
publication_and_delivery: Runtime/render owner; observation after publication/render decision.
contract_notes: Per-frame generic broadcasts can add pressure; retain immutable frame ownership.

current_path: Dispatcher results/futures, EventBus stats and queued error sinks already exist.
recommendation: Retain requester completion and error sinks; optional aggregate health notifications.
publication_and_delivery: Delivery endpoint owns execution; detached simulation batch per boundary.
contract_notes: Immediate errors propagate; queued errors use sink; new/reentrant posts wait for a later drain.

current_path: submit returns requester-owned future; work groups and status provide lifecycle state.
recommendation: Retain futures for job results; publish application/domain completion only after adoption.
publication_and_delivery: Worker execution with result transfer to chosen owner.
contract_notes: Do not call arbitrary game listeners on the worker solely because the future became ready.

occurrence: Worker native policy failed or fell back
current_path: Native placement/policy failures are counted/logged while jobs have futures.
recommendation: Optional coalesced degradation notification with pool identity and fallback outcome.
publication_and_delivery: Worker observation; publish via safe owner after internal locks.
contract_notes: Distinguish policy degradation from job failure; avoid repeated event storms.

occurrence: Worker submissions closed or pool drained
current_path: Explicit close/drain methods, group controls and status.
recommendation: Keep lifecycle control; optional observation does not replace completion barriers.
publication_and_delivery: Pool/runtime owner.
contract_notes: No shutdown listener may enqueue required work onto an already closed endpoint.

current_path: hwloc discovers a retained topology; pool caches topology/capabilities; affinity can be queried.
recommendation: Add topology refresh/rebinding capability before change events.
publication_and_delivery: Native topology owner then runtime policy owner.
contract_notes: Do not claim automatic CPU hotplug handling from current construction-time discovery.

current_path: Synchronous registry mutation returns directly; there is no filesystem watcher.
recommendation: Optional registry revision for independent observers.
publication_and_delivery: Registry caller; publish after complete merge.
contract_notes: Specify replacement/conflict semantics; this is distinct from a disk change.

current_path: FileIndex and registry do not expose a watcher or refresh/removal lifecycle.
recommendation: Design watcher, debounce and registry refresh before events.
publication_and_delivery: File observation service; consumer-specific prepare/upload owners.
contract_notes: File change is not equivalent to successful resource replacement.

occurrence: Asset batch prepared or preparation failed
current_path: prepare returns an owned CPU batch or throws; batch ID/logs exist.
recommendation: Keep direct result; optional batch lifecycle fanout for independent services.
publication_and_delivery: Preparation caller/worker; copied batch identity and counts, not borrowed buffers.
contract_notes: Preparation success does not mean GPU upload or cache publication.

occurrence: Asset batch upload completed or partially failed
current_path: UploadStats/logs are maintained; upload can publish some entries before failure and rethrow.
recommendation: Optional terminal batch outcome with success/partial/failure and completed counts.
publication_and_delivery: Resource-provider owner; publish after commits and outside cache locks.
contract_notes: No rollback guarantee; include batch/provider identity; distinguish committed metadata from attempted work.

occurrence: Cache entry published/replaced or cache cleared
current_path: Cache mutates under locks; internal publish callback only updates metadata under the write lock.
consumers: Hot-reload tools; asset browser; dependent cache services
recommendation: If independent observers are needed, publish key/generation changes after commit and unlock.
publication_and_delivery: Cache mutation owner; delivery on consumer owner.
contract_notes: Old retained handles remain valid; do not auto-rebind immutable frames; never run arbitrary listeners under cache lock.

current_path: reload links before replacing cache; failure preserves old executable; result/exception and logs exist.
recommendation: Optional committed-replacement notification for independent tools.
publication_and_delivery: Provider owner after successful link/cache swap; separate failure observation.
contract_notes: Include key/domain/generation; preserve existing handle lifetime and failure atomicity.

current_path: configure atomically replaces catalogue; consumers retain snapshots by design.
consumers: Theme/font picker; new session creation; tooling
recommendation: Optional configuration revision for observers; explicitly decide any rebind policy.
publication_and_delivery: Font-service configuration owner after unlock.
contract_notes: Notification does not update existing session/font snapshots automatically.

current_path: TextUpdater exposes revision/failure ledger, pending/current and adoption return value.
recommendation: Retain request/adopt result paths; optional fanout after owner adoption.
publication_and_delivery: Worker preparation; provider upload; simulation adoption.
contract_notes: Stages are distinct; superseded results are coalesced and must not be announced as current.

current_path: Animation is metadata sampled at caller-supplied time; engine owns no playback clock here.
recommendation: Publish from the owner of playback state if needed.
publication_and_delivery: Application simulation owner.
contract_notes: A pure cell_at lookup has no transition history; a generic engine event would invent playback state.

current_path: VoiceData detects ma_sound_at_end when state is sampled; public VoiceSnapshot reports Finished only.
recommendation: Add optional completion observation with voice and playback generation.
publication_and_delivery: Non-real-time maintenance or bounded native handoff; deliver on chosen application owner.
contract_notes: Separate natural finish from stop and close; no arbitrary listeners/allocating general dispatch from mixing callback.

current_path: Explicit synchronized controls and state snapshot exist.
recommendation: Keep direct controls; optional observational state fanout for independent tools.
publication_and_delivery: Control owner after releasing backend mutex.
contract_notes: Restart replaces VoiceData; stale completion from previous playback must not end the new playback.

current_path: Public snapshot has loop flag and duration, but no playhead, loop counter or marker model.
recommendation: Add the required timing/marker observation contract before notifications.
publication_and_delivery: Audio clock observation with bounded cross-thread handoff.
contract_notes: Define precision, skipped markers and callback cost; state polling is not sample-accurate timing.

current_path: Output construction/close/status are explicit; audio System is application-owned.
recommendation: Retain explicit lifecycle; optional fanout for independent consumers.
publication_and_delivery: Audio owner; dispatch after backend locks release.
contract_notes: No runtime-owned automatic audio update phase currently exists.

current_path: Wrapper exposes no device-loss/recovery/default-device notification.
recommendation: Design backend observation and recovery states before event channels.
publication_and_delivery: Native audio observation to non-real-time owner.
contract_notes: Do not infer a supported recovery contract from miniaudio's existence.

current_path: play/stream return handles or throw; internal asynchronous initialization is synchronously awaited.
recommendation: Retain return/exception path; callers can explicitly schedule preparation.
publication_and_delivery: Audio request owner.
contract_notes: Internal native notification is not a public asynchronous game event.

current_path: Public PlaybackState has no Failed state or later error ledger; initialization error handling is visible.
recommendation: Investigate native runtime failure observation, then define terminal reason/status and notification.
publication_and_delivery: Native/backend observation to non-real-time audio maintenance.
contract_notes: Source establishes an API/status gap; this audit does not prove which runtime decoder failures occur or are silently lost.

current_path: Explicit construction, owner-thread checks, close and lease release.
recommendation: Retain direct lifetime ownership; automatic subscriptions must detach with session lifetime.
publication_and_delivery: Simulation owner for runtime-integrated sessions.
contract_notes: EventBus Registration is not RAII; prevent queued callbacks after captured session destruction.

occurrence: Widget/document interaction and application UI command
current_path: Native toolkit signal/document mechanisms serve widget interactions.
recommendation: Use toolkit events locally; publish application commands at the UI/controller boundary as needed.
publication_and_delivery: UI session owner.
contract_notes: Do not duplicate every toolkit signal onto the engine bus or change focus-epoch input semantics.

occurrence: Recorded scene uploaded/adopted or upload failed
current_path: Uploader returns future; adopt_scene checks/gets and publishes current result.
recommendation: Retain future/adoption boundary; optional fanout after adoption.
publication_and_delivery: Provider upload owner then session/simulation owner.
contract_notes: Ready GPU work and currently adopted scene are distinct; retained old scenes stay valid.

current_path: Toolkit recordings and retained resource snapshots carry required generation ownership.
recommendation: Keep immutable recording/cache flow.
publication_and_delivery: Toolkit/session owner to provider upload owner.
contract_notes: A global bus is not required to make a recorded scene self-contained.

current_path: Renderer init/deinit, domain checks, lifetime counters and errors expose state.
recommendation: Optional coarse domain lifecycle observation if independent consumers need it.
publication_and_delivery: Platform/context owner outside internal locks.
contract_notes: Do not promise restart/device recovery absent a supporting renderer contract.

current_path: Owner-affine retirement queue, collection and counters already mediate release.
recommendation: Retain retirement mechanism; prefer aggregate statistics for tools.
publication_and_delivery: Final handle release queues; context owner collects.
contract_notes: Arbitrary callbacks per release add locks/reentry risks and cannot replace lifetime barriers.

current_path: GLFW and GL callbacks collect fixed counters/state; safe-phase reporting logs them.
recommendation: Optional coalesced telemetry from safe-phase reporting.
publication_and_delivery: Native callback captures minimal data; owner later reports/publishes.
contract_notes: Do not invoke throwing/allocating general listeners inside native callbacks or recursively report logging failure.

current_path: Provider calls return handles or throw; queued upload paths return futures.
recommendation: Retain direct result and future paths; batch observations belong to A04.
publication_and_delivery: Provider/context owner; requester adoption on appropriate owner.
contract_notes: GPU object availability, frame adoption and presentation are different milestones.

current_path: Camera setters update a local revision; game/render pass chooses matrices copied into frames.
recommendation: Use local revision tracking; optional application observer when multiple owners need it.
publication_and_delivery: Single unsynchronized camera owner.
contract_notes: Revision is not a cross-thread publication barrier; native view W02 can feed the owner without global camera broadcasts.

occurrence: Arguments parsed/validated; context created; startup failed
current_path: Startup callbacks and StartupResult return context/runtime or exit result; failures propagate.
recommendation: Retain direct factory/control sequence; optional host observation only if needed.
publication_and_delivery: Calling startup owner.
contract_notes: Event listeners must not replace required validation/factory decisions.

current_path: Module manages process/IPC lifecycle and notices viewer death via atomic state and stderr.
recommendation: Keep local process supervision; optional host-facing status for tools.
publication_and_delivery: Process supervisor; copied process status.
contract_notes: Independent helper process need not depend on engine EventBus lifetime.

current_path: Header is a scaffold; there is no runtime implementation to trace.
recommendation: Require common event conformance when implementing the backend.
publication_and_delivery: Future platform adapter contract.
contract_notes: Do not report missing dispatches as a defect in an unimplemented backend.

current_path: Synchronous callbacks run on caller thread outside storage lock, including equal sets.
recommendation: Retain documented local observer; use owner delivery when crossing threads.
publication_and_delivery: Caller-owned synchronous observation.
contract_notes: Exceptions can skip later callbacks; not EventBus or automatic simulation delivery.

current_path: Revisioned value and wait/notify coalesce changes; equal values do not advance revision.
recommendation: Retain latest-state semantics; use separate occurrence stream only when every transition matters.
publication_and_delivery: Versioned storage synchronization.
contract_notes: A change counter is not unread event history or cancellation support.

current_path: State machine provides direct synchronous transition hooks.
recommendation: Publish domain transitions from the owning machine if independent consumers require them.
publication_and_delivery: Caller-owned state machine.
contract_notes: No global engine-owned machine exists here; avoid automatic global broadcasts for every template instance.

occurrence: Allocation returned/released or release invariant failed
current_path: Retained owners and validated release paths already manage lifetime; final-owner invariant failure reports and terminates.
recommendation: Keep ownership/error mechanism; optional aggregate instrumentation outside allocator critical sections.
publication_and_delivery: Allocation/release owner; emergency reporting on fatal failure.
contract_notes: No general EventBus dispatch from deleters, allocator locks or fatal reporting.

current_path: Explicit facade setters and file lifecycle callbacks exist; initial destination config remains immutable.
recommendation: Retain dedicated callbacks/control; optional application-owner status with owned values.
publication_and_delivery: Backend operations invoke file callbacks on their executing thread.
contract_notes: Paths/FILE pointers are borrowed only during callback; protect captures and obey reentry rules.

occurrence: Backend degraded or shared queue discarded output
current_path: BackendStats and shared QueueStats expose sampled failures/discards; diagnostic reporting exists.
recommendation: Optional coalesced health snapshot from a safe owner phase.
publication_and_delivery: Sample outside backend callback/locks; deliver independently of failing logging path.
contract_notes: Avoid recursive event/log failures; queue totals span categories and are not per-record delivery acknowledgements.
